mechanisms.U: Terminate only on 16 distinct accepted successful clears, otherwise old flow. Action prefix => virtual time nonincrease under published model.
mechanisms.K: When 16 channels observed, skip remaining discovery and clear all known ones; terminate only on 16 successful distinct clears. Count-certified absence, no fabricated station negatives. Time dominance not proven.

development: Same 52 configs, both rounding modes; all known adverse layouts can be reused only as development.
selection: Select lowest bounded development mean among configurations whose all-case means and p95 do not worsen REF in both rounding modes; require complete audited runs. All six go into fresh validation if a candidate qualifies, to preserve ablations.
validation: Same mean/p95/full-clear gates in each new ordinary/outer rounding batch. No retuning or mode selection using hidden truth.
